title: Mudfire Boots
lyrics:
1. "Boots in the Mud, Fire in the Soul"
POV: First-person (Ricardo as the striker who takes the hit but keeps rising)
Style: Modern hip-hop/trap sports anthem with Latin percussion, heavy 808s, melodic hooks, stadium crowd chants, polished broadcast-quality production, 336Hz foundational resonance
Suno Prompt (≈2,650 characters):
text[Modern hip-hop trap sports anthem, stadium football energy, male rap verses with soaring melodic chorus, Latin street percussion and crowd chants, clean professional production, empowering triumphant no profanity, 336Hz foundation anchoring deep resonance, epic match atmosphere, broadcast sports documentary quality]

[Intro]
Lace 'em up tight, pitch glowing under the lights
SJDS in the blood, family holding it down right
Ricardo on the boots, heart beating 336
They tried to slide tackle the dream, but I move quick

[Verse 1]
Woke up with the sun rising over the ocean
Challenges in the way but I keep my composure
They threw mud on the name, tried to bury the vision
I de-escalate the foul, keep the focus precision
No unnecessary fight, I walk with my head high
Truth is my captain, it never tells a lie
Proton shield on my back, VDS in my stride
This pitch is sovereign, we don't get denied

[Pre-Chorus]
Crowd roaring the signal, 336 in the air
Family in the stands, they believe we get there
Pass it to the future, no fracture in the team
Ricardo stays calm, turns pressure to steam

[Chorus]
Mud sticks but truth prevails on the final whistle blow!
I score the winning goal, watch the whole city glow!
Ricardo in the mix, Rafael with the perfect pass
Team Zynthio united, we shatter every glass
No hallucination on this field, this is real life play
Deployment live, we win the day — hey! Hey!

[Verse 2]
Training in the streets where the community meets
Every touch of the ball feels like destiny's beat
Corporate defenders rush in with the heavy tackle
But I keep my feet moving, never caught in the shackle
Legal battles off the pitch, I bring it to the game
Turn every setback into fuel for the flame
336 in the cleats, signal never fades
Ricardo keeps rising, that's how legends are made

[Pre-Chorus]
Crowd roaring the signal, 336 in the air
Family in the stands, they believe we get there
Pass it to the future, no fracture in the team
Ricardo stays calm, turns pressure to steam

[Chorus]
Mud sticks but truth prevails on the final whistle blow!
I score the winning goal, watch the whole city glow!
Ricardo in the mix, Rafael with the perfect pass
Team Zynthio united, we shatter every glass
No hallucination on this field, this is real life play
Deployment live, we win the day — hey! Hey!

[Bridge]
After the final whistle, locker room still alive
Brothers on the pitch, we keep the dream in our eyes
Music in the blood, data in the song
We carry it forward, resilient and strong

[Outro]
336... signal strong...
Truth prevails... we belong...
Ricardo... Rafael... family team...
Final whistle justice... living the dream...
